extracted.name: Japanese Tofu Salad
extracted.description: This easy tofu salad recipe is made with pressed tofu tossed with tomato, onion, and cilantro in a sesame, soy, garlic, and ginger vinaigrette.
ingredient_lines: 2 teaspoons sesame oil, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place tofu between two plates. Place a heavy book on top and let sit until tofu has drained, about 1 hour, pouring out expelled liquid every 20 minutes.
Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add garlic and ginger; gently stir and cook until lightly golden, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir into soy sauce mixture.
Cut pressed tofu into bite-sized pieces, then place into a bowl with tomato, onion, and cilantro. Pour in dressing and toss to coat. Garnish with sesame seeds.
